scope: Source mechanics, minimum indexed apparatus and eligibility; no verified numeric growth hierarchy.

sourceMechanics.setup: Standing straight/EZ bar curl, braced torso, no hip impulse; slight shoulder flexion is optional.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Bar geometry and wrist comfort vary. No exact lengthened torque or head-specific credit is established.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Standing supinated free-bar role; numeric ratings remain programming judgements.

sourceMechanics.setup: Seated incline dumbbell curl on a 45–80-degree backrest, upper arms behind the torso.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Longer muscle position does not guarantee high bottom-range torque; this depends on forearm orientation relative to gravity.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Supported shoulder-extended dumbbell role; length is not bottom-range torque.
Generic shoulder-extended cable role; support, laterality and cable geometry are not specified.

sourceMechanics.setup: Seated machine preacher curl with upper arms supported; guide recommends stopping short of full elbow lockout.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Cam, axis and machine geometry determine torque. MACHINE alone cannot validate LENGTHENED resistance or an ideal profile score; the endpoint recommendation is not a universal safety rule.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Supported machine preacher role; machine-specific resistance remains unverified.

sourceMechanics.setup: Standing dumbbell hammer curl without torso swing; optional slight shoulder flexion.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Neutral grip does not establish a precise biceps/brachialis/brachioradialis attribution fraction.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Neutral-grip elbow-flexor role; no precise brachioradialis credit is established.

sourceMechanics.setup: Standing low-cable bar curl with optional slight shoulder flexion.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Cable tension is not joint torque; pulley height, distance and forearm angle change bottom/top loading.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Neutral-shoulder cable role; constant cable tension is not constant joint torque.

sourceMechanics.setup: Seated unilateral concentration curl, upper arm supported against the inner thigh.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Loading increments and bilateral elapsed time need implementation-specific treatment; no superior growth or precise local fatigue score is inferred.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Thigh-supported unilateral alternative; unilateral elapsed-time modeling remains open.

sourceMechanics.setup: Chest-supported spider curl on a 45–60-degree incline bench.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Support reduces balance demands, not all technique demands. A free-weight curve does not establish comparative regional hypertrophy.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Chest-supported flexed-shoulder role; growth head-specificity remains unverified.
Overhead cable extension: the lengthened-long-head role tested directly by Maeo et al. 2023.

sourceMechanics.setup: Seated two-hand dumbbell extension; elbow action, shoulder held flexed.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Dumbbell increments and shoulder comfort depend on the athlete.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Overhead role without a cable station; coarser dumbbell increments.

sourceMechanics.setup: Supine bar extension behind the head; EZ or straight bar.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Bar type and wrist comfort are not established by the generic catalogue name.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Flexed-shoulder barbell extension; the single-joint arm of Brandao et al. 2020.

sourceMechanics.setup: High-cable rope pushdown, elbow-only action, no forced rope separation.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Rope versus cuff growth superiority is not established.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Same neutral-shoulder role as the bar pushdown with another attachment.

sourceMechanics.setup: V1 high-cable bar pushdown with fixed shoulder and elbow position.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Full elbow excursion does not imply resistance at the very end of extension.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Neutral-shoulder complement with low skill demand and stack increments.

sourceMechanics.setup: Seated machine elbow extension with shoulder/arm support.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Manufacturer-specific ROM, axis and cam cannot be inferred from MACHINE.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Supported, low-skill extension; the specific machine geometry stays unverified.
Bodyweight hybrid for equipment-limited plans; coarse loading and end-range shoulder extension.
Triceps-primary press. It currently counts as direct triceps work; that definition is allocator debt.

sourceMechanics.setup: Seated low-cable rope extension behind the head.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Cable tension is not constant joint torque; pulley distance changes the curve.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Same overhead-cable role as extension-sobre-cabeza-polea, plus a bench.

sourceMechanics.setup: Supine neutral-grip extension; dumbbells descend behind the head.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Elbow flexion and actual upper-arm angle determine the lengthened demand.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Fills the flexed-shoulder dumbbell role, but its promotion experiment was rejected: a near-zero time squeeze then drops 2.5-4 chest sets in dumbbell-only plans.

sourceMechanics.setup: Standing dumbbell overhead extension; no leg impulse.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Title and instructions specify dumbbells but the figure shows a bar; default follows the instructions.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Same role as the seated overhead dumbbell entry with less support; source text and figure disagree.

sourceMechanics.setup: Supine skullcrusher toward forehead or nose, distinct from behind-head French press.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Endpoint clearance can restrict elbow flexion.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Near-duplicate of press-frances with a shorter endpoint.

sourceMechanics.setup: Narrow-grip dip with both shoulder and elbow movement; external loading optional.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: No direct hypertrophy hierarchy versus machines is established; equipment includes bars and optional belt.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Hybrid dip classified as a horizontal press; it would fill the chest-press slot before its role is decided.

sourceMechanics.setup: Crossed high cables with cuffs or independent handles; elbow extension.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Two cable stations required for the bilateral description; optional shoulder motion is not the default.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Needs two cable stations, which availability does not model.

sourceMechanics.setup: One high cable, lateral stance, shoulder held fixed.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Cable line and torso orientation determine resistance.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Unilateral, doubling time per set, in a role the pushdowns already cover.

sourceMechanics.setup: Seated at 80-90 degree backrest, shoulders near 90 degrees; independent cables.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Support does not establish ideal machine/cable resistance matching.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Needs independent cables and a backrest, which availability does not model.

sourceMechanics.setup: Standing unilateral elbow extension with shoulder near 90 degrees.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Do not translate 90-degree shoulder flexion into fully overhead.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Unilateral flexed-shoulder role already covered bilaterally.

sourceMechanics.setup: Low cable behind head, diagonal katana extension, shoulder held flexed.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: No direct katana-versus-other-extension growth comparison.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Unilateral overhead role already covered bilaterally.

sourceMechanics.setup: Cable Tate extension on a 20-45 degree bench, independent low cables.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Despite press in the name, the source holds the shoulder fixed.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Needs two low cables and a bench, which availability does not model.

sourceMechanics.setup: Kaz/JM hybrid on Smith rails; elbow travels, bar approaches chin/clavicle.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Rail geometry and technique matter; superiority over close-grip bench is a coaching claim.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Technique-dependent press-extension hybrid in the close-grip-bench role; revisit with beginner eligibility.

sourceMechanics.setup: Free-bar JM hybrid; elbows travel forward, bar approaches chin/clavicle.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: No validated fixed chest credit or comparative growth advantage.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Technique-dependent press-extension hybrid in the close-grip-bench role; revisit with beginner eligibility.

sourceMechanics.setup: High cable behind body, description specifies shoulders near 90 degrees.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Figure appears more overhead than the 90-degree description; exact equivalence unresolved, preserved separately.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Disputed identity: the text says 90-degree shoulder flexion, the figure looks overhead.

sourceMechanics.setup: V2 pushdown deliberately couples elbow extension and shoulder extension.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Coordination-heavy variant; no evidence for a quantified long-head bonus.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Coordination-heavy coupled elbow and shoulder extension.

sourceMechanics.setup: V3 leaned-over pushdown, shoulders held above the bar, elbows travel backward.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Source describes a slight pressing component; hybrid accessory, not a basic press.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Hybrid with a pressing component in the pushdown role.

sourceMechanics.setup: Supine low-cable French extension; fixed shoulder is the default.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Optional shoulder motion would define a different execution, not mandatory hybrid status.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Needs a cable and a bench; the flexed-shoulder role is already covered.

sourceMechanics.setup: Supine Tate extension with laterally directed elbows, no shoulder press.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Kettlebell option is not availability of the default dumbbell variant.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Unusual lateral elbow path; guide-199 covers the flexed dumbbell role.

sourceMechanics.setup: Unilateral high-cable pushdown with shoulder fixed near torso.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: The kickback label does not imply a dumbbell-like terminal-loading curve.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Unilateral pushdown.

sourceMechanics.setup: Bent-over cable kickback, free hand supported, pulley below shoulder.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Pulley height can shift demand from early/mid to late elbow extension.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Unilateral kickback.

sourceMechanics.setup: Machine French extension, upper arm on pad, shoulder near 90 degrees.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Cam, axis alignment and available elbow excursion vary by manufacturer.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Same supported-machine role as extension-triceps-maquina; manufacturer-specific.

sourceMechanics.setup: Standing chest-height extension, usually crossed cables, shoulder near 90 degrees.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Cable height changes peak demand; no muscle-head multiplier is inferred.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Needs two cable stations, which availability does not model.

sourceMechanics.setup: Supine cable kickback, shoulder fixed, long/double ropes clear the torso.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Bench or mat and cable placement needed; not a standing overhead variant.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Needs long or double ropes and a bench at the cable.

sourceMechanics.setup: Back-to-high-cable unilateral pushdown with line near shoulder.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Usually unilateral; a two-hand execution requires a suitable cable portal.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Unilateral pushdown.

sourceMechanics.setup: High-cable pushdown using bar/multigrip plus independent handles.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Attachment requirements differ from an ordinary bar pushdown.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Needs a multigrip plus independent handles in the pushdown role.

sourceMechanics.setup: Seated two-dumbbell overhead French extension.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Distinct loading/hand setup from the one-dumbbell two-hand entry.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Same overhead dumbbell role as extension-sobre-cabeza-mancuerna.

sourceMechanics.setup: Seated unilateral diagonal katana extension.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Free-hand support is optional; vertical alignment unloads the terminal elbow range.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Unilateral, and vertical alignment unloads the terminal range.

sourceMechanics.setup: High-cable elbow extension with torso on 45-60 degree bench.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Source contains a shoulder-motion typo; fixed shoulder is consistently specified elsewhere.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Needs a bench at the cable; the neutral role is already covered.

sourceMechanics.setup: Rapunzel pushdown using extra-long crossed ropes near shoulders.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Cable/rope clearance matters; ordinary short ropes are not an equivalent setup.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Needs extra-long ropes.

sourceMechanics.setup: Supine PJR combines elbow extension and substantial shoulder movement.
sourceMechanics.uncertainty: Dumbbell is the indexed default; bar alternative is not silently equipment-equivalent.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Hybrid with substantial shoulder movement; technique-dependent.

sourceMechanics.setup: Standing Roman/triceps-bar hammer curl; neutral handles, elbow flexion without torso impulse.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: A specialty neutral-handle bar is required; generic barbell availability cannot establish it. Fixed wrists do not establish superior hypertrophy.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Requires a specialty Roman bar, not established by ordinary BARBELL availability.

sourceMechanics.setup: Seated dumbbell curl, starts neutral and supinates during elbow flexion. Backrest is optional.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: A seat is required for this source variant; a standing alternative is described separately. Optional support and supination do not establish a quantitative stimulus bonus.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Seated rotating-grip variant; optional support and elapsed time are not modeled precisely.

sourceMechanics.setup: Standing straight/EZ-bar drag curl; elbows travel behind the torso while the bar rises. Optional wall/back support.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Shoulder motion and coordination make it distinct from a fixed-upper-arm curl. The guide long-head emphasis claim is not a validated growth multiplier.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Moving-shoulder drag hybrid; no secondary muscle fraction is inferred.

sourceMechanics.setup: Seated incline dumbbell curl on a 45–80-degree backrest, upper arms behind the torso.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Longer muscle position does not guarantee high bottom-range torque; this depends on forearm orientation relative to gravity.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Related to the existing incline curl; retain saved identity without duplicate promotion.

sourceMechanics.setup: Seated bilateral Bayesian curl, 80–90-degree backrest and two independent low cables.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Generic standing Bayesian identity lacks the specified bench and dual-cable support; do not transfer stability or availability automatically.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Distinct seated bilateral Bayesian setup requiring a bench and two cable lines.

sourceMechanics.setup: Unilateral dumbbell preacher, upper arm on a 45–60-degree incline bench; elbow stays supported.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Bench support is required. Avoiding final elbow extension is a guide preference, not a universal safety rule; short-head growth superiority is unverified.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Unilateral dumbbell preacher; benchmark dose/time behavior before automatic promotion.

sourceMechanics.setup: Unilateral low-cable preacher with an independent handle and upper-arm support on a 45–60-degree bench.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Bench and cable geometry determine availability and torque. Constant cable tension does not imply constant elbow torque or a universally optimal resistance profile.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Unilateral cable preacher with an adjustable bench and independent handle.

sourceMechanics.setup: Chest-supported spider curl on a 45–60-degree bench with straight/EZ bar.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Gravity loads according to forearm angle. The guide short-head preference is not a validated credit multiplier.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Bar spider variant overlaps the chest-supported role; no individual numeric rating.

sourceMechanics.setup: Chest-supported 45–60-degree bench spider curl facing a low cable with bar attachment.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: The cable changes force direction, not necessarily constant elbow torque; bench distance changes the curve.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Bench/cable spider variant; cable geometry and numeric rating remain unresolved.

sourceMechanics.setup: Seated curl machine with elbows supported behind the torso and feet bracing the seat.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: This is not a shoulder-flexed preacher machine. Its cam and available ROM require specific machine inspection.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Specific behind-body machine is not implied by generic machine availability.

sourceMechanics.setup: Standing low-cable preacher-style curl with arms held forward, two independent handles, no arm pad.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Preacher in the title does not imply support; a unilateral alternative is a separate setup.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Unsupported standing preacher-style curl; not equivalent to an arm-pad preacher.

sourceMechanics.setup: Bilateral high-cable double-biceps curl with upper arms held out to the sides; standing or kneeling.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Abducted-shoulder bilateral high curl requires two cables; not sagittal shoulder flexion.

sourceMechanics.setup: Bilateral low-cable hammer curl using two nearby cables and separate rope handles; no wrist rotation.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: The default needs two cable lines; a single-rope or unilateral implementation is not identical apparatus or elapsed time.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Default needs two nearby cable lines; a unilateral alternative is a different implementation.

sourceMechanics.setup: Supine guillotine curl on a flat/slightly inclined bench, high cable and bar directed toward the face.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: The source notes little demand when the cable aligns with the forearm; this does not justify a numeric growth rating.

eligibilityDecision.reason: High-cable supine role; alignment-dependent torque does not establish a numeric preference.

sourceMechanics.setup: Standing high-cable preacher-style curl facing a head-height pulley, unilateral handle default.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: No arm pad is present. Optional hand support/kneeling changes stability; an elbow endpoint is not a universal safety rule.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Unsupported high-cable unilateral role; no generic preacher-support bonus.

sourceMechanics.setup: Curl over the near-vertical reverse side of a Scott pad with EZ bar; dumbbells are an optional alternative.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Reverse describes the bench orientation, not a pronated grip. It must not be relabeled as a forearm/reverse-grip curl.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Reverse side of Scott bench, not reverse grip; preserve distinct setup.

sourceMechanics.setup: Seated conventional Scott preacher with straight/EZ bar, upper arms supported on the forward-sloping pad.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Pad angle and forearm orientation set external torque; the guide preference for other implements is not universal comparative evidence.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Free-bar supported preacher differs from the existing machine preacher.

sourceMechanics.setup: Supine crucifix curl on a flat/slightly inclined bench between widely separated independent cables.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Cable span can restrict elbow ROM for a given arm length; a generic cable flag cannot establish this setup.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Wide-portal supine crucifix can be ROM-limited; verify apparatus and alignment.

sourceMechanics.setup: Supine 45–60-degree bench curl facing a high cable with a straight/EZ attachment, shoulders fixed.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Support differs from the standing high curl. Alignment can unload the extended elbow despite cable tension.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Bench-supported high cable requires separate setup and individual rating.

sourceMechanics.setup: Supine 30–45-degree bench curl between two low cables; shoulder neutral or mildly flexed according to setup.

sourceMechanics.setup: Standing unilateral Bayesian curl with cable behind the torso; free-hand support is recommended, not mandatory.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Standing unilateral Bayesian with optional hand support; not the seated bilateral source.

sourceMechanics.setup: Seated high-curl specialty machine with upper arms supported and handles moving toward the face.
sourceMechanics.unresolved: Generic machine availability does not establish this specialty device or its cam, axis alignment and usable ROM.

eligibilityDecision.reason: Specialty high-curl machine requires individual apparatus availability and rating.
